This '''female [[Human/Legends|Human]]''' was the wife of [[Bordon]] and mother of [[Tallo (Star-Wake)|Tallo]] and [[Wend]]. She fought for the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] during the [[Ruusan campaign]] and was killed in battle by the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] during the [[Fourth Battle of Ruusan]].<ref name="ROT" />
